Mat’s on the hunt to find the best fast estate he has ever driven!

He’s been lucky enough to get his hands on a whole load of practical, insanely fast, and highly desirable super estates over the past few years. From compact V6 load-luggers through to ultra-heavy hybrid V8 monsters, Mat has had his hands on some of the quickest wagons in the world. But which one tops the list as his favourite?

Let’s start with a look at the contenders.

Starting with the BMW M3 Touring, it’s powered by a 3.0-litre twin-turbo straight-six that produces 510hp and 650Nm. Power is sent to all four wheels via an 8-speed automatic transmission, and the car weighs approximately 1,865kg. In terms of desirability, it’s easily one of the most highly anticipated M cars of the decade!
